import pandas as pd

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the first numerical index column
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_71/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_71/training_1.csv"

df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# Operation 1: JOIN Source2_71_0 and Source2_71_1 on "school_name"
df_joined = pd.merge(df0, df1, on="school_name", how="inner")

# Operation 2: group_by Source2_71_0.type and aggregate avg(Source2_71_1.reading_score)
result = df_joined.groupby("type", as_index=False)["reading_score"].mean()

# Rename columns to match target schema exactly
result = result.rename(columns={"type": "type", "reading_score": "reading_score"})

# Ensure the data types match target schema: 'type' as string, 'reading_score' as float
result["type"] = result["type"].astype(str)
result["reading_score"] = result["reading_score"].astype(float)

# Write the result to the target path
target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_71/target_multisource.csv"
result.to_csv(target_path, index=False)
